target: 553 Dimidiata Nympha

source: 553 Half-Fairy
target: 553 Dimidiata Nympha

source: Lumian remained composed, not rushing to summon the messenger of the Minor Arcana, the Knight of Swords.
target: Lumian manebat sedatus, non festinans nuntium Arcanae Minoris, Equitem Gladii, vocare.

source: His patience persisted as he waited for a particular individual.
target: Patientia eius perseveravit, dum exspectabat aliquem destinatum.

source: Since expressing a strong desire to investigate the sea prayer ritual and taking action, only three waves of people had contacted him today, openly or covertly.
target: Ex eo quod vehementer cupivisset ritum precationis maritimae explorare et agere, hodie solum tres undae hominum, sive aperte sive occulte, eum contulerunt.

source: Yet, the person he awaited the most had not shown up.
target: Attamen, persona quam maxime exspectabat nondum apparuit.

source: Maybe Rubió Paco prefers to wait until late at night when there’s no one around?
target: Forsitan Rubió Paco mavult exspectare usque ad noctem serotinam, cum nemo adest?

source: Shaking off his thoughts, he smiled at Lugano.
target: Cogitationes removens, ad Lugano subridens.

source: “Batna just began his fling with Nolfi.
target: “Batna modo negotium amoris cum Nolfi incipit.

source: He might want to explore all the villages, towns, pastures, and vineyards around Port Santa before the sea prayer ritual.
target: Fortasse velit explorare omnes vicos, oppida, prata, et vineas circa Portum Santum ante ritum precationis maritimae.

source: If you hear anything about him later, inform me.
target: Si posthac quid de eo audieris, mihi nuntia.

source: There’s no need to deliberately inquire.
target: Non opus est intentionaliter quaerere.

source: Lugano didn’t think it was a big deal and smiled understandingly.
target: Lugano non existimavit rem magnam esse, et intellegenter subridens.

source: “Maybe he even took on some missions along the way—earning some bucks while traveling.”
target: “Forsitan etiam aliquas missiones perrexit, pecuniam parvam merens.

source: Once the interpreter and Ludwig retired to their rooms, Lumian settled into a recliner and casually perused the Highlander textbooks under the soft glow of the gas wall lamp.
target: Cum interpres et Ludwig ad cubicula sua recedebant, Lumian in solio reclinato se instituit et leviter libros Highlander sub molli luce lampadis murariae gasii perlegit.

source: As time passed, the night grew quieter.
target: Tempore cedente, nox quietior facta est.

source: Lumian, confirming no further intel would arrive that night, pondered the situation.
target: Lumian, certo scito nihil amplius illam nocte venturum esse, rem meditatus est.

source: Stroking his chin, he pondered this matter.
target: Mentum frotans, hanc rem meditatus est.

source: It seems more people are observing.
target: Videtur plures homines spectare.

source: Unless the great adventurer’s investigation makes a breakthrough and remains unscathed, they won’t easily place their bets until I demonstrate greater reliability or value.
target: Nisi investigatio magni audaci exploratoris novam viam patefecerit atque intactus mansisset, non facile sortes suas constituent, donec maiorem constantiam aut valorem ostenderim.

source: The trio who reached out today possesses distinct traits.
target: Trio, qui hodie se contulerunt, proprietates distinctas habent.

source: One affiliated with the Earth Mother Church, insulated from losses even if their gamble fails.
target: Unus, Ecclesiae Matris Terrae affiliatus, a damnis immunus, etiam si alea sua deficeret.

source: Would the Fisheries Guild risk confrontation with the cathedral and the Fertility Order?
target: Num Gildia Piscaria certamen cum cathedral et Ordine Fertilitatis capere auderet?

source: The second, the imposter Governor of the Sea, faces high odds of death during the sea prayer ritual.
target: Secundus, impostor Praefectus Maris, magnas probabilitates mortis in ritu precationis maritimae habet.

source: He’d clutch at any chance for survival.
target: Omnem occasionem ad salutem arripere volebat.

source: Additionally, his lack of confidence in both the Earth Mother Church and Port Santa’s government makes him value the adventurer capable of defeating the Demon Warlock more.
target: Praeterea, infirma fiducia in et Ecclesiam Matris Terrae et gubernationem Portus Sancti efficit ut adventorem, qui Daemonium Magum superare valeat, magis aestimet.

source: However, his plea might be a trap by the Fisheries Guild.
target: Tamen supplicatio eius fortasse insidiae a Gildia Piscaria est.

source: The third, elusive figure hinted at useful clues without divulging the sea prayer ritual’s secret…
target: Tertius, figura elusoria, indicia utilia insinua est, sed secretum ritus precationis maritimae non revelavit…

source: After careful contemplation, Lumian gained deeper insight into the mindsets and choices of various factions.
target: Post accuratam meditationem, Lumian profundius mentes et decisiones variarum factionum intellexit.

source: Conspiracies often manipulated human emotions, exploiting the circumstances at hand.
target: Coniurationes saepe affectus humanos manipularunt, circumstantias praesentis usus facientes.

source: Lumian found himself increasingly fascinated by these two aspects.
target: Lumian se magis ac magis his duobus aspectibus fascinari invenit.

source: This was both a daily routine and an essential necessity.
target: Hoc erat tam consuetudo cotidiana quam necessitas vitalis.

source: Putting aside the Highlander textbook, Lumian returned to his bedroom.
target: Librum Highlander deieciens, Lumian ad cubiculum suum rediit.

source: Closing the door, a black mark on his body emitted a faint glow.
target: Claudens ianuam, atrum signum in corpore suo levem lucem edidit.

source: Bottle of Fiction!
target: Vas Fictum!

source: Lumian enveloped the entire room within the Bottle of Fiction.
target: Lumian totam conclave in Vas Fictum complectus est.

source: The entry conditions were simple—only spirit world creatures.
target: Conditiones ingressus erant simplices—solae creaturae mundi spirituum.

source: Ripple-like light briefly adorned the walls, floor, and ceiling of the bedroom before swiftly vanishing, leaving everything appearing entirely ordinary.
target: Lumen undarum simile paulisper parietes, pavimentum, et laquearia cubiculi ornavit, deinde celeriter evanuit, omnia omnino ordinaria relinquens.

source: Only then did Lumian compose the letter and arrange the ritual.
target: Tunc solum Lumian epistulam composuit et ritum ordinavit.

source: He sanctified the dagger, erected a wall of spirituality, and lit the candle representing him.
target: Pugionem sanctificavit, murum spiritualitatis erexit, et candelam, quae eum repraesentat, accendit.

source: Stepping back, he spoke in ancient Hermes, “I!”
target: Retrocedens, in antiqua lingua Hermetica locutus est: “Ego!”

source: Then, switching to Hermes, he said, “I summon in my name:
target: Deinde, in lingua Hermetica vertens, dixit: “In nomine meo evoco:

source: “A peculiar creature wandering above the world, a half-fairy who fiddles with melodic strings, a messenger that belongs solely to the Knight of Swords…”
target: “Creatura peculosa per orbem errans, dimidiata nympha, quae chordas melodicas ludit, nuntius qui solum Equesti Gladii est…”

source: The orange candle flame transformed instantly into a deep blue hue, expanding to half the size of a human.
target: Flamma candelæ aurantii statim in profundum caeruleum colorem conversa est, ad dimidiem hominis magnitudinem expandens.

source: In the blue radiance, a figure of blood‑red hue emerged from the candle flame.
target: In splendore caeruleo, figura sanguine rubra ex flamma candelæ exorta est.

source: Resembling a female human in form, it shared traits with a creature Lumian had encountered in Cordu’s ruins.
target: Forma femina humanae similis, proprietates habebat cum creatura quam Lumian in ruinis Cordi convenerat.

source: Devoid of skin or external coverings, it exposed bloody muscles, bluish‑black blood vessels, ghastly white tendons, oily yellow fat, and large red or white fascia.
target: Sine cute aut tegumentis externis, musculos sanguinolentos, vasa sanguinea nigrocaerulea, tendines horride albos, adipem flavum oleosum, et fascias magnas rubras aut albas patefecit.

source: Lumian studied the 1.7‑meter‑tall Knight of Swords messenger and pondered silently, Does Half‑Fairy mean it’s divided internally?
target: Lumian, nuntium Equestis Gladii, qui 1.7 metrorum altus erat, consideravit tacite, atque meditatus est: “Num Dimidiata Nympha internis partibus divisa sit?”

source: I assumed it would be either split vertically or horizontally…
target: Existimavi id aut verticaliter aut horizontaliter divisi esse…

source: Don’t you know how to fiddle with melodic strings? Where are they?
target: Nescisne quomodo chordis melodicis modulandum exerceas? Ubi illa sunt?

source: With these musings racing through his mind, Lumian handed the folded letter to the messenger and politely uttered in Hermes, “Kindly deliver this to the Knight of Swords.”
target: His cogitationibus in mente cursantibus, Lumian epistulam plicatam nuntio tradidit et comiter in lingua Hermetica dixit: “Quaeso, hanc ad Equestem Gladii perfer.”

source: As his strength grew, Lumian became increasingly aware that most messengers he encountered could be lethal—if unafraid to unleash the corruptive source, Termiboros.
target: Crescente vi, Lumian paulatim intellexit plerosque nuntios quos conveniebat letales esse posse—si non timebant fontem corruptionis, Termiboros, efferre.

source: Though Lumian couldn’t gauge the strength of the Knight of Swords’ messenger—the Half‑Fairy—all his experience urged him to maintain politeness.
target: Quamquam Lumian virtutem nuntii Equestis Gladii—Dimidiatae Nymphae—non aestimare potuit, omnis eius experientia eum ad urbanitatem retinendam adhortabatur.

source: The black and white eyeballs of the Half‑Fairy, embedded in the blood‑colored face, darted around before gently nodding and accepting the letter.
target: Oculi nigri et albi Dimidiatae Nymphae, in facie sanguinea colorata insiti, circumvolitaverunt antequam leniter annuens epistulam accepit.

source: It spoke with a clear, pleasant voice akin to a mountain stream’s flow, “I’ll deliver it promptly.”
target: Ea loquebatur voce clara et amoena, instar sonitus fluminis montani, “Celeriter id perferam.”

source: How melodious.
target: Quam melodiosa.

source: It’s like a bard strumming a guitar… Lumian snapped out of his reverie.
target: Instar bardus citharam pulsans est… Lumian ex meditatione sua evigilavit.

source: He suddenly grasped the reason for the messenger’s melodic string prefix.
target: Subito intellexit causam praefixi chordarum melodicarum nuntii.

source: “Thank you.”
target: “Gratias tibi ago.”

source: He bowed politely.
target: Comiter inclinavit.

source: Observing the Half‑Fairy about to retreat into the blue candle flame, Lumian couldn’t suppress his curiosity and inquired, “What would you do if given human skin?”
target: Observans Dimidiatam Nympham, quae in flammam candelæ caeruleæ se retrahere parata esset, Lumian curiositatem reprimere non potuit et quaesivit: “Quid facies, si cutem humanam accipias?”

source: The Half‑Fairy fixed its black‑and‑white eyes on Lumian for a few seconds.
target: Dimidiata Nympha oculos nigros et albos in Lumian paucis momentis fixit.

source: As it delved into the blue candle flame, it left behind a melodious voice, “I’ll put it on.”
target: Dum in flammam candelæ caeruleæ se immergit, post se vocem melodiosam reliquit: “Induem illud.”

source: You’ll embody whoever’s skin you wear? Has the Half‑Fairy always sought its other half? Lumian speculated.
target: Num incarnabis eum, cuius cutem geres? Num Dimidiata Nympha semper alteram partem suam quaesiverit? Lumian hoc speculatus est.

source: At that moment, he recalled an unfinished promise.
target: Illo momento, promissum imperfectum meminit.

source: Help the Abscessed Hand find its body!
target: Adiuvā Manum Abscessam corpus suum invenire!

source: This pledge determined whether Lumian could attain godhood and advance to Sequence 4.
target: Hoc pactum definivit num Lumian deitatem adipisci posset et ad Ordinem Quartum ascendere.

source: However, being only a Sequence 6, he wasn’t in a rush.
target: Attamen, cum solum esset in Ordine Sexto, non festinabat.

source: Late at night, in Trier’s market district, within an empty room.
target: Nocte sero, in regione mercatoria Treverensi, intra conclave vacuum.

source: Franca, clad in an assassin suit, was having her first face‑to‑face encounter with 007.
target: Franca, habitu sicario induta, primum conventum facie ad faciem cum 007 habebat.

source: As moments drifted by, 007 strode in, sporting a brown lion headgear and a double‑breasted coat.
target: Dum momenta transibant, 007 incedebat, gerens galeam leonis fuscae et vestem duplici pectorali.

source: After confirming his identity, Franca pushed back her hood, emerging from the shadows.
target: Postquam identitatem confirmavit, Franca cucullum suum repellens ex umbris emergit.

source: “What brings us to this in‑person discussion?” 007 inquired, his brow furrowed.
target: “Quid nos ad hanc in persona disputationem ducit?” interrogavit 007, fronte contrahente.

source: His instincts screamed to decline, yet he sensed the gravity of the situation.
target: Instinctus eius ad recusandum clamare videbantur, attamen gravitatem rei sensit.

source: Failing to act promptly could result in a colossal catastrophe.
target: Celeriter agere non potuisse ingentem catastropham inferre posset.

source: Ultimately, he acceded to Hidden Blade’s request for a meeting.
target: Denique petitioni Hidden Blade de conventu assensit.

source: Franca chuckled, emotions swirling within.
target: Franca subridens, interiores animi motus circumvolitantes, ridebat.

source: “It’s a good thing.”
target: “Bona res est.”

source: “I’m skeptical when it comes from you, Hidden Blade,” 007 expressed his concern openly.
target: “A te, Hidden Blade, dubito,” 007 aperte curam suam efferens dixit.

source: Franca clarified her reason for requesting an “offline” meeting, “It’s true. I need your help to find someone.
target: Franca causam suam ad conventum “offline” petendum enuntiavit: “Verum est. Auxilio tuo aliquem invenire mihi opus est.

source: Telegrams can’t convey a portrait.
target: Telegrammata picturam transmittere non possunt.

source: I can’t craft a digital image using just words and dots, can I?”
target: Imaginem digitalem tantis verbis et punctis solis conficere non possum, an non?

source: 007 regarded Franca with suspicion.
target: 007 Francam cum suspicione contemplavit.

source: “Simply seeking help to locate someone? No ulterior motives?”
target: “Solum auxilium quaeris ad aliquem inveniendum? Nulla ulterior voluntas est?”

source: Franca chuckled.
target: Franca subridens ridebat.

source: “For now, that’s all I can divulge.”
target: “Nunc tantum hoc patefacere possum.”

source: “That only heightens my apprehension.”
target: “Id solum sollicitudinem meam auget.”

source: 007 keenly sensed the search for this individual might harbor a crucial issue.
target: 007 acerrime sensit quaesitum huius individui rem gravem latere.

source: Otherwise, Hidden Blade, having witnessed catastrophic events, wouldn’t have taken it so seriously.
target: Alio modo, Hidden Blade, catastropha visa, non id tam graviter sustinuisset.

source: She wouldn’t have insisted on an offline meeting and handing over the portrait personally.
target: Non institeret ad conventum offline et picturam personaliter tradere.

source: More likely, she would have left it somewhere for retrieval.
target: Verisimiliter, eam alicubi relinquisset ad recuperationem.

source: Franca produced a portrait, drawn through dream divination and ritualistic magic, and passed it to 007.
target: Franca picturam, per divinationem somniorum et magiam ritualem confectam, 007 tradidit.

source: Upon receiving it, 007’s hand naturally emitted a sunlight‑like glow, revealing the photo‑like drawing in the dark night.
target: Accipiens, manus 007 naturaliter radiante luce solari similis effudit, ostendens picturam quasi photographicam in nocte obscura.

source: The depicted figure wore a black robe, with his head slightly turned, revealing very short dark hair that seemed freshly grown.
target: Figura depingata vestem nigrum gerebat, capite leviter converso, ostendens crines breves et obscuros, quasi nuper creti.

source: The facial contours on his side profile were gentle, and his sickly pale‑white skin contrasted with his dark brown eyes, which were not sunken enough.
target: Lineamenta faciei lateralis eius lenia erant, et cutis pallida, quasi aegrota, contraria erat oculis fusco‑brunneis, quae non satis demissae erant.

source: Initially, 007 perceived nothing remarkable, but trusting Hidden Blade’s knack for stirring trouble, he scrutinized it for more than ten seconds.
target: Initio, 007 nihil insolitum percepit, sed fidens in arte Hidden Blade ad tumultum excitandum, illud plus quam decem secundis perscrutatus est.

source: Beneath the lion’s headgear, his brow furrowed as he whispered, “This doesn’t seem like someone from any country in the Northern Continent.”
target: Sub galea leonis, supercilium contraxit dum susurravit, “Hic non videtur ex quacumque terra in Continente Septentrionali esse.”

source: Franca smiled playfully and self‑deprecatingly.
target: Franca ludenter et sui ipsius deprecatione subridens ridebat.

source: “Don’t you think he resembles us from before we transmigrated?”
target: “Non putasne eum simile esse nobis, antequam transmigrati essemus?”

source: 007 froze, as if struck by lightning.
target: 007 immobilis factus est, quasi fulmine percussus.

source: He studied the drawing repeatedly and fell silent for nearly 20 seconds before saying,
target: Illud pictum iterum atque iterum examinavit et paene viginti secundis tacitus mansit, antequam dixerit,

source: “Hidden Blade, do you understand what you’re saying?”
target: “Hidden Blade, intellegisne quid dicis?”

source: Franca raised her head slightly and said in a deep voice, “I suspect he came from that country from our world.
target: Franca paulum caput attollens, voce profunda dixit, “Suspicio eum ex illa terra nostrae mundi venit.

source: “Muggle, I, and the others found signs of interaction between both worlds before!”
target: “Muggle, ego et ceteri signa interactionis inter utrumque mundum prius invenimus!”

source: “When? What signs?” 007 interjected, fighting the urge to grab Hidden Blade’s shoulder and shake her for every bit of information.
target: “Quando? Quae signa?” interposuit 007, contendens impulsum ut humerum Hidden Blade arriperet atque eam concuteret pro singulis informationis particulis.

source: Franca chuckled.
target: Franca subridens ridebat.

source: “I’m not at liberty to answer you.
target: “Non licet mihi tibi respondere.

source: I can only reveal it after discussing with Muggle and the others.
target: Illud tantum patefacere possum postquam cum Muggle et ceteris colloquar.

source: There are many secrets involved.
target: Multa arcana implicata sunt.

source: First, discreetly search for the person in the portrait.
target: Primum, caute quaere personam in pictura.

source: I encountered him on the fourth level of the catacombs.”
target: Eum in quarto gradu catacumbarum conveni.

source: 007 struggled to contain his impatience, resisting the temptation to handcuff Hidden Blade for details.
target: 007 impatiens conabatur impetum suum continere, resistens temptationi ut Hidden Blade ad notitias particulariter vincirentur.

source: Through gritted teeth, he said, “Can’t you guys discuss it first before involving me?”
target: Inter dentes contritos, dixit: “Num prius ea disputare non potestis, antequam me implicetis?”

source: I was just considerate of your emotions, afraid that you’d lose control upon receiving so much information at one go…
target: Mihi solum cura erant affectus vestri, timeo ne, simul tantam informationem accipiatis, moderationem amitteretis…

source: Franca let out a hollow laugh and replied,
target: Franca risum vacuam edidit et respondit,

source: “It’s not time to meet Muggle and the others yet.
target: “Nondum tempus est Muggle et ceteros conveniendi.

source: I need to find him urgently, afraid he might leave Trier.
target: Eum celeriter inveniendum habeo, ne Trier relinqueret.

source: “Calm down, calm down.
target: “Quiesce, quiesce.

source: You can’t hide your desire to kill me.”
target: Non potes celare desiderium tuum me interficendi.

source: Franca smiled sheepishly, fading into the shadows.
target: Franca verecunde subridens in umbras evanuit.

source: Holding the portrait, 007 took a deep breath and exhaled slowly.
target: Picturam tenens, 007 altum spiritum traxit et lente expiravit.

source: Feynapotter Kingdom, Port Santa, Solow Motel.
target: Regnum Feynapotter, Portus Sanctus, Solow Motel.

source: After breakfast, Lumian had just returned to the master bedroom when he sensed a sudden chill.
target: Post ientaculum, Lumian modo ad cubiculum principale redierat, cum subitam frigiditatem sensit.

source: Simultaneously, a tarot card materialized on the desk.
target: Simul, charta taroti in mensa apparuit.

source: The card depicted a knight running with a sword in hand.
target: Charta depictum ostendebat equitem currens gladium in manu gerentem.

source: Minor Arcana card, Knight of Swords!
target: Charta Arcana Minor, Eques Gladii!
